description.value: Kitchen on the Ridge is a family-owned restaurant that has been serving Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows since 2005, offering a full dine-in menu alongside weekend Dim Sum service. Situated on the Lougheed Highway, it is a convenient meal stop for cyclists traveling through the Fraser Valley corridor.
